title: Final low-machine cohort: direct facsimile closure of the dictionary/appendix boundary
provenance_note: AI-assisted direct visual collation against the user-supplied Steffel 1809 facsimile. The final 16 low-confidence candidates were re-aligned across printed pp. 367–368. Machine candidates assigned to p. 369 were shown to derive from the right column of p. 368; p. 369 itself begins the appendix (`Anhang. I. Von der tarahumariſchen Art zu zählen.`) and contributes no residual dictionary headword. Independent human/philological and linguistic validation remains pending.

RHD-S1809-02427.note: OCR `Hach. Tichipl...` is the split continuation of `Flach` plus the p. 367 catchword for the next page, not a lexical headword.

RHD-S1809-02428.note: OCR `BL ARE CAR` is non-lexical noise generated at the p. 367/368 page break.

RHD-S1809-02449.note: `Ohrfeige` is the second German gloss in `Tſchotſchonála, Maulſchelle. Ohrfeige.`, not a Rarámuri headword.

RHD-S1809-02471.note: `Sünder` continues the p. 368 article `Tſetijolájameke, Uebelthäter. Sünder.`; the candidate starts on the gloss, not the headword.

RHD-S1809-02479.note: `Waſſer hat` continues `Vaſſürſchi, Wo es warmes Waſſer hat.` and is not a headword.

RHD-S1809-02495.note: `Mörtel` is the cross-reference at the end of `Vuoſſaguáca, Ziegelerde, ſ. Mörtel.`, not a separate Rarámuri headword.

RHD-S1809-02415.note: Direct facsimile resolves OCR `Tiehach` and confirms the cross-reference `ſ. Staar.`.

RHD-S1809-02425.note: Direct facsimile resolves OCR `Tichinſf` as the Rarámuri headword followed by `ſ. Gewebe.`.

RHD-S1809-02481.note: Direct facsimile resolves OCR `Vene Zahm` as `Veníameke, Zahm.`.

notes.dictionary_appendix_boundary: Printed p. 368 is the final dictionary page. Printed p. 369 begins the appendix with `Anhang. I. Von der tarahumariſchen Art zu zählen.`. No FR-027 candidate belongs to the appendix after direct page/column re-alignment.
notes.page_span_correction: The final cohort resolves entirely to printed pp. 367–368. Fifteen machine page placements are corrected: seven p. 368 estimates belong to p. 367 and all eight p. 369 estimates belong to p. 368.
notes.direct_image_review: All 16 dispositions were made with direct page-image access.
